harrat-mujtaba:7-7.t: The clause «سخَّرها» is a naʿt (adjective) of «ريح»; «سبع» is an adverb of time attached to (mutaʿalliq) «سخرها»; «حسوما» is a naʿt of «سبع»; the clause «فترى» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause «سخَّرها»; the preposition and its genitive noun «فيها» is attached to «ترى»; «صرعى» is a ḥāl (circumstantial); and the clause «كأنهم أعجاز» is a second ḥāl from «القوم».

harrat-mujtaba:8-8.t: The clause «فهل ترى» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause {فَتَرَى الْقَوْمَ}; «باقية» is mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and «من» is redundant (zāʾida).

harrat-mujtaba:9-9.t: The clause «وجاء فرعون» is resumptive; «من» is a relative noun conjoined (maʿṭūf) to «فرعون»; the preposition and its genitive noun «بالخاطئة» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «فرعون» and those with him.

harrat-mujtaba:10-10.t: The clause «فعصوا» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause «جاء», and «أخذة» is a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object).

harrat-mujtaba:11-11.t: The conditional clause is parenthetical, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, what follows indicating it; the clause «حملناكم» is the khabar (predicate) of «إن».

harrat-mujtaba:12-12.t: The interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) «لنجعلها» is genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) {حَمَلْنَاكُمْ}; the preposition and its genitive noun «لكم» is attached to the second object of «جعل».

harrat-mujtaba:13-13.t: The fāʾ is resumptive; the preposition and its genitive noun «في الصور» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «نفخ», and «نفخة» is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent).

harrat-mujtaba:14-14.t: The clause «حُملت» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause {نُفِخَ}; «دكة» is a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object).

harrat-mujtaba:15-15.t: The fāʾ connects the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of «إذا» in verse (13); this fāʾ was attached to the apodosis, though originally it is not attached to it, because of its connection with the adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) the apodosis «وقعت», this adverb being a badal (substitute) from «إذا». His saying «وقعت الواقعة» is permissible because «الواقعة» has become a proper name for the Resurrection by predominant usage; originally «قام القائم» ("the stander stood") is not permissible, since there is no benefit in it. «إذٍ» is a muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and its tanwīn is a substitute for a clause, i.e.: on the day when the Trumpet is blown.

harrat-mujtaba:16-16.t: The clause «فهي واهية» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause «انشقت».

harrat-mujtaba:17-17.t: The clause «والملك على أرجائها» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause «انْشَقَّتِ السَّمَاءُ»; the clause «ويحمل ثمانية» is conjoined to the clause «الملك على أرجائها»; «فوقهم» is an adverb of place attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «ثمانية»; «يومئذ» is attached to «يحمل», and «إذٍ» is a muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).

harrat-mujtaba:18-18.t: The adverb «يومئذ» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «تُعرضون»; the clause «تُعرضون» is a badal (substitute) from the clause {وَقَعَتِ}; the clause «لا تخفى» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the pronoun in «تُعرضون»; the preposition and its genitive noun «منكم» is attached to a ḥāl from «خافية».

harrat-mujtaba:19-19.t: The conditional clause is resumptive; «من» is a relative noun, a mubtadaʾ (subject); the fāʾ is connective (rābiṭa); the clause «يقول» is the khabar (predicate) of «مَنْ»; «هاؤم» is a verbal noun of command (ism fiʿl amr) meaning "take"; and the clause «اقرءوا» is a badal (substitute) from the clause «هاؤم».

harrat-mujtaba:20-20.t: The clause «إني ظننت» is resumptive within the scope of the saying; «أنَّ» with what follows it stands in place of the two objects of «ظن»; «حسابيه» is the object of «ملاق»; the yāʾ is a muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and the hāʾ is for the pause (hāʾ al-sakt).

harrat-mujtaba:21-21.t: The clause «فهو في عيشة» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:22-22.t: (في جنة عالية) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The preposition and its genitive noun is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the [notion of] being-settled (al-istiqrār) to which the khabar (predicate) in the previous verse is attached.

harrat-mujtaba:23-23.t: The clause «قطوفها دانية» is a naʿt (adjective) of {جَنَّةٍ}.

harrat-mujtaba:24-24.t: The clause «كلوا» is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl) of an implied (muqaddar) saying, and the implied clause of saying is resumptive; «هنيئًا» is a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an omitted verb; the preposition and its genitive noun «بما» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «هنيئا»; the preposition and its genitive noun «في الأيام» is attached to «أسلفتم».

harrat-mujtaba:25-25.t: The clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause «من أوتي» in verse (19); «من» is a relative noun, a mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause «فيقول» is the khabar (predicate); «يا» is a particle of drawing attention (tanbīh); «كتابيه» is a second object; the yāʾ is a muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and the hāʾ is for the pause (hāʾ al-sakt).

harrat-mujtaba:26-26.t: «ما» is an interrogative noun, a mubtadaʾ (subject), and «حسابيه» is the khabar (predicate); the clause stands in place of the two objects of «أَدْرِ», suspended by the interrogative.

harrat-mujtaba:27-27.t: (يا ليتها كانت القاضية) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The clause is resumptive within the scope of the saying, and «القاضية» is the khabar (predicate) of «كانت».

harrat-mujtaba:28-28.t: The clause «ما أغنى» is resumptive; «ما» is negative; «ماليه» is the fāʿil (agent), and the hāʾ is for the pause (hāʾ al-sakt).

harrat-mujtaba:29-29.t: The clause «هلك عني سلطانيه» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:30-30.t: The clause «خذوه» is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl) of an implied (muqaddar) saying.

harrat-mujtaba:31-31.t: «الجحيم» is a fronted second object, and the clause «صَلُّوه» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause {خُذُوهُ}.

harrat-mujtaba:32-32.t: The preposition and its genitive noun «في سلسلة» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «اسلكوه», and there is no need to assume an implied clause; the clause «ذرعها سبعون» is a naʿt (adjective) of «سلسلة»; «ذراعا» is tamyīz (specification); the clause «اسلكوه» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause «صَلّوه», and the fāʾ is redundant (zāʾida).

harrat-mujtaba:35-35.t: The clause «فليس له حميم» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause «لا يحض»; «اليوم» is an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) the [notion of] being-settled (al-istiqrār) to which the khabar (predicate) of «ليس» is attached; «هاهنا»: «ها» is for drawing attention (tanbīh), and «هنا» is an adverb of place attached to what «اليوم» is attached to.

harrat-mujtaba:36-36.t: «إلا» is for restriction (ḥaṣr); the preposition and its genitive noun «من غسلين» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «طعام».

harrat-mujtaba:37-37.t: The clause «لا يأكله» is a naʿt (adjective) of {غِسْلِينٍ}.

harrat-mujtaba:40-40.t: (إنه لقول رسول كريم) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The clause is the answer to the oath.

harrat-mujtaba:41-41.t: The clause «وما هو بقول» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the answer to the oath; «ما» is negative, acting like ليس, and the bāʾ is redundant (zāʾida) in its khabar (predicate); «قليلا» is a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), and «ما» is redundant; the clause «تؤمنون» is parenthetical.

harrat-mujtaba:42-42.t: «ما» is redundant (zāʾida); the clause «تذكرون» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:43-43.t: «تنزيل» is the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e.: it (هو); the preposition and its genitive noun «من رب» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «تنزيل».

harrat-mujtaba:44-44.t: The clause «ولو تقوَّل» is resumptive, and «بعض» is mafʿūl bihi (direct object).

harrat-mujtaba:47-47.t: «أحد» is the noun of «ما», and «من» is redundant (zāʾida); «ما» is negative, acting like ليس; the preposition and its genitive noun «منكم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «أحد»; «حاجزين» is the khabar (predicate) of «ما»; the preposition and its genitive noun «عنه» is attached to «حاجزين»; «حاجزين» is plural only according to the meaning, because «أحدًا» is general in a context of negation.

harrat-mujtaba:48-48.t: The clause «وإنه لتذكرة» is resumptive; the preposition and its genitive noun «للمتقين» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «تذكرة».

harrat-mujtaba:49-49.t: The clause «وإنَّا لنعلم» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the resumptive clause; «أن» with what follows it stands in place of the two objects of «نعلم»; the preposition and its genitive noun «منكم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate) of «أن».

harrat-mujtaba:50-50.t: The clause «وإنه لحسرة» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause {وَإِنَّا لَنَعْلَمُ}; the preposition and its genitive noun «على الكافرين» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «حسرة».

harrat-mujtaba:52-52.t: The clause «فسبِّح» is resumptive; «العظيم» is a naʿt (adjective) of «ربك».

mekki-muskil:1-2.t: His saying, the Exalted: {الحاقة ما الحاقة}: (الحاقة) is a mubtadaʾ (subject); (ما) is a second mubtadaʾ, and (ما) has the interrogative sense, whose meaning is magnification and wonder; the second (الحاقة) is the khabar (predicate) of (ما); and (ما) with its khabar is the khabar of the first (الحاقة). It is permissible for the clause to be a khabar of it although there is no pronoun in it referring back to the mubtadaʾ, because it is construed according to the meaning "The Inevitable Hour: how great and how terrible it is!" It is also said the meaning is "The Inevitable Hour: what is it?", by way of magnifying its matter; then the noun was made overt to be clearer in magnification. This was already mentioned in al-Wāqiʿa. Its like is (القارعة ما القارعة).

mekki-muskil:3-3.t: His saying (وما أدراك ما الحاقة): (ما) is a mubtadaʾ (subject); the second (ما) is a second mubtadaʾ and (الحاقة) is its khabar (predicate); the clause is in the position of the accusative governed by (أدراك). (أدراك) and what is connected to it are the khabar of the first (ما). In (أدراك) there is a pronoun as fāʿil (agent) referring back to the first (ما). The first and second (ما) are interrogatives, and that is why (أدراك) did not govern the second (ما) but governed the clause; both are interrogatives carrying the meaning of magnification and wonder. (أدراك) is a verb that takes two objects: the kāf is the first object and the clause is in the position of the second. Its like is (وما أدراك ما يوم الدين ثم ما أدراك ما يوم الدين), (وما أدراك ما عليون), (وما أدراك ما العقبة) and (وما أدراك ما القارعة); all of it follows one analogy, so measure some of it against the rest.

mekki-muskil:5-5.t: His saying (فأما ثمود فأهلكوا): (ثمود) is nominative as a mubtadaʾ (subject) and (فأهلكوا) is the khabar (predicate). The fāʾ properly belongs before it; the implied form is: "Whatever may be, Thamūd were destroyed." (ثمود) is a name for the tribe and is definite, so it is a diptote because of femininity and definiteness. It is also said that it is a foreign definite noun, which is why it is a diptote. It is permissible to make it fully declinable in speech, and it has been read so in places in the Qur'an other than this one, taking it as the name of the forefather. Its like is (وأما عاد فأهلكوا), except that (عاد) is fully declinable because of its lightness, since it has three letters with the middle one vowelless, like Hind, Daʿd, Miṣr and the like.

mekki-muskil:7-7.t:
His saying (سبع ليال وثمانية أيام): (سبع) and (ثمانية) are accusative as adverbials (ẓarf). (حسوما) is a naʿt (adjective) of (الأيام), meaning "consecutive". It is also said that it is accusative as a maṣdar (verbal noun), meaning "in succession".
His saying (فيها صرعى): in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial), because (ترى) is from seeing with the eye.
His saying (كأنهم أعجاز نخل): the clause is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl from the pronoun in (صرعى), i.e. "resembling the trunks of palm trees hollow from rot".

mekki-muskil:15-15.t: His saying (فيومئذ وقعت الواقعة): the governor of the adverbial is (وقعت).

mekki-muskil:16-16.t: His saying (فهي يومئذ واهية): the governor of the adverbial is (واهية).

mekki-muskil:18-18.t: His saying (يومئذ تعرضون): the governor of the adverbial is (تعرضون).

mekki-muskil:28-28.t: His saying (ما أغنى عني ماليه): (ما) is in the position of the accusative governed by (أغنى) [Translator's note: i.e. interrogative]. It is also permissible for it to be negating, with the object of (أغنى) omitted, i.e. "My wealth has availed me nothing."

mekki-muskil:32-32.t: His saying (ذرعها سبعون): a mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar (predicate), in the position of the genitive (khafḍ) as a naʿt (adjective) of (سلسلة).

mekki-muskil:41-41.t: His saying (قليلا ما تؤمنون) and (قليلا ما تذكرون): (قليلا) is accusative in this place, governed by (تؤمنون) and (تذكرون), and (ما) is redundant (zāʾida). Its true nature is that it is a naʿt (adjective) of an omitted maṣdar (verbal noun) or of an omitted adverbial, the implied form being "for a little time you remember" or "a little remembering you remember"; likewise (قليلا ما تؤمنون). It is not permissible to make (ما) with the verb a maṣdar and make (قليلا) accusative by what comes after (ما), because that would put part of the ṣila (relative clause) before the relative, since whatever the maṣdar governs is always within the ṣila of the maṣdar and may not precede it.

mekki-muskil:43-43.t:
His saying (تنزيل من رب العالمين): the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e. "It is a revelation."
His saying (عنه حاجزين): a naʿt (adjective) of (أحد), because it has the meaning of a group, so the adjective was construed according to the meaning and made plural.

muyesser-irab:49-49.t:
﴿وإنا﴾: likewise a conjunction; and inna, with ﴿نا﴾ as the ism (noun) of inna.
﴿لنعلم﴾: the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); and نعلم is an imperfect verb, with its fāʿil (agent) a latent (mustatir) pronoun; the clause نعلم is the khabar (predicate) of inna.
﴿أن﴾: an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh) that puts the noun in the accusative and the predicate in the nominative; أن together with what follows stands in place of the two objects of نعلم.
﴿منكم﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted, fronted khabar of أن.
﴿مكذبين﴾: the postponed ism of أن.

muyesser-irab:50-50.t:
﴿وإنه﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; inna is an abrogating particle; and the hāʾ is an indeclinable (mabnī) pronoun in the position of the accusative (manṣūb) as the ism of inna.
﴿لحسرة﴾: the lām: the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); and حسرة is the khabar (predicate) of inna.
﴿على الكافرين﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿تذكرة﴾, or a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿حسرة﴾. [Translator's note: ﴿تذكرة﴾ does not occur in this ayah; it is the word of the ayah 48 (﴿وإنه لتذكرة للمتقين﴾), apparently carried over from there. Here the word is ﴿حسرة﴾.]

muyesser-irab:51-51.t:
﴿وإنه﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; inna is an abrogating particle; and the hāʾ is an indeclinable (mabnī) pronoun in the position of the accusative (manṣūb) as the ism of inna.
﴿لحق﴾: the lām: the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); and حق is the khabar (predicate) of inna.
﴿اليقين﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).

muyesser-irab:52-52.t:
﴿فسبح﴾: the fāʾ of eloquence (al-fāʾ al-faṣīḥa); and سبّح is an imperative verb.
﴿باسم﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿سبح﴾; or the bāʾ is connective (ṣila).
﴿ربك﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿العظيم﴾: a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿ربك﴾.

muyesser-irab:1-1.t: ﴿الحاقة﴾: «الحاقة» is a mubtadaʾ (subject) and what follows it is its khabar (predicate); or it is the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ.

muyesser-irab:2-2.t:
﴿ما﴾: «ما» is an interrogative noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn, in the position of a nominative (marfūʿ) as a mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿الحاقة﴾: the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ. The nominal clause is the khabar of «الحاقة», and the link (rābiṭ) is the repetition of the mubtadaʾ in its own wording. The clause ﴿الحاقة ما الحاقة﴾ is initial (ibtidāʾiyya).

muyesser-irab:3-3.t:
﴿وما﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, or parenthetical (iʿtirāḍiyya). ﴿ما﴾ is an interrogative noun in the position of a nominative (marfūʿ) as a mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿أدراك﴾: a past verb; the kāf is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); the clause is the khabar (predicate) of «ما».
﴿ما﴾: the second [«ما»], likewise an interrogative noun in the position of a nominative as a mubtadaʾ.
﴿الحاقة﴾: the khabar; the clause ﴿ما الحاقة﴾ is in the position of an accusative (manṣūb), standing in place of the second and third objects of the verb ﴿أدراك﴾, because «أدرى» takes three objects in the accusative. The clause ﴿ما أدراك ما الحاقة﴾ is conjoined to the preceding clause, or parenthetical, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:4-4.t:
﴿كذبت﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position; «كذبت» is a past verb.
﴿ثمود﴾: the fāʿil (agent).
﴿وعاد﴾: conjoined to «ثمود».
﴿بالقارعة﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿كذبت﴾.

muyesser-irab:5-5.t:
﴿فأما﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and «أما» is a particle of condition and detailing (tafṣīl).
﴿ثمود﴾: a mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿فأهلكوا﴾: the fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb) of «أما»; «أهلكوا» is a past verb built for the one whose agent is not named (passive), and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent).
﴿بالطاغية﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أهلكوا﴾; the clause is the khabar (predicate) of «ثمود».

muyesser-irab:6-6.t:
﴿وأما﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and «أما» is a particle of condition and detailing (tafṣīl).
﴿عاد﴾: a mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿فأهلكوا﴾: the fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb) of ﴿أما﴾; «أهلكوا» is a past verb built for the one whose agent is not named (passive), and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent).
﴿بريح﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أهلكوا﴾; the clause ﴿فأهلكوا﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of «عاد».
﴿صرصر﴾: an adjective (ṣifa) of ﴿ريح﴾, made genitive (majrūr) by the kasra.
﴿عاتية﴾: likewise an adjective of ﴿ريح﴾.

muyesser-irab:7-7.t:
﴿سخرها﴾: a past verb and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), referring back to Allah; the clause is a third adjective (ṣifa) of ﴿ريح﴾.
﴿عليهم﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿سخرها﴾.
﴿سبع﴾: accusative as an adverb of time (ʿalā al-ẓarfiyya al-zamāniyya).
﴿ليال﴾: a muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿وثمانية﴾: conjoined to «سبع ليال».
﴿أيام﴾: a muḍāf ilayhi.
﴿حسوما﴾: a naʿt (adjective) of «سبع ليال وثمانية أيام»; or a maṣdar (verbal noun) made accusative (manṣūb) by a verb from its own root, i.e.: «تحسمهم حسومًا» (cutting them off utterly); or a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the object of «سخرها», i.e.: «ذات حسوم» (possessing cutting-off); or a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose).
﴿فترى﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; «ترى القوم»: an imperfect verb and a latent fāʿil.
﴿القوم﴾: a mafʿūl bihi.
﴿فيها﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿ترى﴾.
﴿صرعى﴾: a ḥāl, because seeing here is visual.
﴿كأنهم﴾: «كأن» is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and ﴿هم﴾ is its noun.
﴿أعجاز﴾: the khabar (predicate) of «كأن», in the nominative (marfūʿ).
﴿نخل﴾: a muḍāf ilayhi.
﴿خاوية﴾: a naʿt of ﴿نخل﴾, in the genitive (majrūr); the clause ﴿كأنهم...﴾ is a ḥāl from «القوم», or resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:8-8.t:
﴿فهل﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and «هل» is an interrogative particle.
﴿ترى﴾: an imperfect verb in the nominative (marfūʿ); its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being «أنت» (you).
﴿لهم﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿ترى﴾.
﴿من﴾: a redundant (ṣila) preposition.
﴿باقية﴾: genitive (majrūr) in form and accusative (manṣūb) in position, because it is the object of «ترى».

muyesser-irab:9-9.t:
﴿وجاء﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position, or conjoined to what precedes it; «جاء» is a past verb.
﴿فرعون﴾: the fāʿil (agent).
﴿ومن﴾: conjoined to «فرعون».
﴿قبله﴾: an adverb of time attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿مَن﴾; the clause of the ṣila has no grammatical position.
﴿والمؤتفكات﴾: likewise conjoined.
﴿بالخاطئة﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿جاء﴾.

muyesser-irab:10-10.t:
﴿فعصوا﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; «عصوا» is a past verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent).
﴿رسول﴾: a mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿ربهم﴾: a muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿فأخذهم﴾: conjoined to ﴿فعصوا﴾.
﴿أخذة﴾: it stands in for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object).
﴿رابية﴾: a naʿt (adjective). The hamza of «أخذة» takes fatḥa because it is a maṣdar of single occurrence (maṣdar marra), not a maṣdar of manner (maṣdar hayʾa); the meaning of manner is derived only from the naʿt.

muyesser-irab:11-11.t:
﴿إنا﴾: «إن» is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and ﴿نا﴾ is its noun.
﴿لما﴾: a temporal adverb (ẓarfiyya ḥīniyya), or linking.
﴿طغى﴾: a past verb.
﴿الماء﴾: the fāʿil (agent), in the nominative (marfūʿ).
﴿حملناكم﴾: a past verb; ﴿نا﴾ is the fāʿil and the kāf is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is the khabar (predicate) of «إن».
﴿في الجارية﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿حملناكم﴾.

muyesser-irab:12-12.t:
﴿لنجعلها﴾: the lām is for giving the reason (taʿlīl); «نجعلها» is an imperfect verb made accusative (manṣūb) by an implied (muḍmara) «أن» after the lām; the interpreted maṣdar formed from «أن» and the verb is made genitive (majrūr) by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿حملناكم﴾; ﴿ها﴾ is the first object of «نجعلها», and the fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun.
﴿لكم﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿تذكرة﴾: a second mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿وتعيها﴾: accusative by conjunction to «نجعل», and ﴿ها﴾ is a mafʿūl bihi.
﴿أُذن﴾: the fāʿil, in the nominative (marfūʿ).
﴿واعية﴾: a naʿt (adjective) of «أُذن».

muyesser-irab:13-13.t:
﴿فإذا﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya), and the clause after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position; «إذا» is an adverb for future time containing the meaning of condition, attached to (mutaʿalliq) its apodosis (jawāb).
﴿نفخ﴾: a past verb built for the one whose agent is not named (passive); the clause is in the position of a genitive (majrūr) by the annexation of the adverb to it.
﴿في الصور﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿نفخ﴾.
﴿نفخة﴾: the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), in the nominative (marfūʿ).
﴿واحدة﴾: a naʿt (adjective), in the nominative.

muyesser-irab:14-14.t:
﴿وحملت﴾: a past verb built for the one whose agent is not named (passive), conjoined to «نفخ».
﴿الأرض﴾: the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent).
﴿والجبال﴾: conjoined to «الأرض».
﴿فدكتا﴾: likewise conjoined; «دك» is a past verb built for the one whose agent is not named; the tāʾ is the quiescent tāʾ of the feminine; and the alif is the nāʾib fāʿil.
﴿دكة﴾: it stands in for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object).
﴿واحدة﴾: a naʿt (adjective), in the accusative (manṣūb).

muyesser-irab:15-15.t:
﴿فيومئذ﴾: the fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); ﴿يومئذ﴾: «يوم» is an adverb of time attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿وقعت﴾, and «إذٍ» is a noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on a sukūn implied (muqaddar) because the place is occupied by the nunation of compensation (tanwīn al-ʿiwaḍ), in the position of a genitive (majrūr) as a muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the nunation compensates for a clause, the implied form being: «يوم إذ نفخ في الصور نفخة واحدة وحملت الأرض والجبال...» etc. (on the day when the Trumpet is blown with a single blast and the earth and the mountains are lifted …).
﴿وقعت﴾: a past verb, and the tāʾ is for the feminine.
﴿الواقعة﴾: the fāʿil (agent), in the nominative (marfūʿ).

muyesser-irab:16-16.t:
﴿وانشقت﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and «انشقت» is a past verb.
﴿السماء﴾: the fāʿil (agent).
﴿فهي﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and «هي» is a mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿يومئذ﴾: «يوم» is an adverb of time attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿واهية﴾, and «إذٍ» is a noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on a sukūn implied (muqaddar) because the place is occupied by the nunation of compensation (tanwīn al-ʿiwaḍ), in the position of a genitive (majrūr) as a muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the nunation compensates for a clause.
﴿واهية﴾: the khabar (predicate) of «هي».

muyesser-irab:17-17.t:
﴿والملك﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), and «الملك» is a mubtadaʾ (subject), in the nominative (marfūʿ).
﴿على أرجائها﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate) of «الملك».
﴿ويحمل﴾: an imperfect verb in the nominative.
﴿عرش﴾: a mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿ربك﴾: a muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿فوقهم﴾: an adverb in the accusative (manṣūb), attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from «العرش», i.e.: in the state of its being above the angels.
﴿يومئذ﴾: «يوم» is an adverb of time attached to ﴿يحمل﴾, and «إذٍ» is a noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on a sukūn implied (muqaddar) because the place is occupied by the nunation of compensation (tanwīn al-ʿiwaḍ), in the position of a genitive (majrūr) as a muḍāf ilayhi; the nunation compensates for a clause.
﴿ثمانية﴾: the fāʿil (agent), in the nominative.

muyesser-irab:18-18.t:
﴿يومئذ﴾: «يوم» is an adverb of time attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿تعرضون﴾, and «إذٍ» is a noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on a sukūn implied (muqaddar) because the place is occupied by the nunation of compensation (tanwīn al-ʿiwaḍ), in the position of a genitive (majrūr) as a muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the nunation compensates for a clause.
﴿تعرضون﴾: an imperfect verb built for the one whose agent is not named (passive), and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent).
﴿لا﴾: negating.
﴿تخفى﴾: an imperfect verb, made nominative (marfūʿ) by a ḍamma implied on the alif.
﴿منكم﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), because it was originally an adjective (ṣifa) of ﴿خافية﴾.
﴿خافية﴾: the fāʿil (agent), in the nominative; the clause is a ḥāl from the wāw in «تعرضون».

muyesser-irab:19-19.t:
﴿فأما﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya), and «أما» is a particle of condition or detailing (tafṣīl).
﴿من﴾: a relative noun in the position of a nominative (marfūʿ) as a mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿أُوتي﴾: «أوتي» is a past verb built for the one whose agent is not named (passive).
﴿كتابه﴾: the second mafʿūl bihi (direct object), the first being the latent (mustatir) nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause ﴿أوتي﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿مَن﴾, with no grammatical position.
﴿بيمينه﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أُتي﴾, and the hāʾ is a muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿فيقول﴾: the fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb) of «أما», and the clause «يقول» is the khabar (predicate) of «من».
﴿هاؤم﴾: a verbal noun of command (ism fiʿl amr) in the sense of «خذوا» (take); the fāʿil (agent) is latent, its implied form being «أنتم» (you); the clause is the maqūl al-qawl (object of saying).
﴿اقرءوا﴾: an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is in the position of an accusative (manṣūb) as a badal (substitute) from ﴿هاؤم﴾.
﴿كتابيه﴾: a mafʿūl bihi, made accusative by a fatḥa implied on what precedes the yāʾ; the yāʾ is a muḍāf ilayhi, and the hāʾ is for the pause (hāʾ al-sakt); the clause ﴿فأما من أوتي...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:20-20.t:
﴿إني﴾: «إن» is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and the yāʾ is its noun.
﴿ظننت﴾: a past verb, and the tāʾ is the fāʿil (agent); the clause is in the position of the khabar (predicate) of «إن».
﴿أني﴾: «أن» is an abrogating particle, and the yāʾ is its noun.
﴿ملاقٍ﴾: the khabar of «أن», the sign of its being nominative (marfūʿ) being the ḍamma implied on the yāʾ that was dropped because of the meeting of two quiescent letters; the «أن» clause stands in place of the two objects of «ظن».
﴿حسابيه﴾: the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of ﴿ملاق﴾, because it is the active participle; the yāʾ is a muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and the hāʾ is for the pause (hāʾ al-sakt).

muyesser-irab:21-21.t:
﴿فهو﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ that discloses an implied condition), and «هو» is a mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿في عيشة﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate) of «هو».
﴿راضية﴾: a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿عيشة﴾, in the genitive (majrūr).

muyesser-irab:22-22.t:
﴿في جنة﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted badal (substitute) from His saying «في عيشة».
﴿عالية﴾: an adjective (ṣifa).

muyesser-irab:23-23.t:
﴿قطوفها﴾: a mubtadaʾ (subject), in the nominative (marfūʿ), and ﴿ها﴾ is a muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿دانية﴾: the khabar (predicate), in the nominative; the clause is a second adjective (ṣifa) of ﴿جنة﴾.

muyesser-irab:24-24.t:
﴿كلوا﴾: an imperative verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); the clause is the object of an omitted saying, i.e.: that is said to them.
﴿واشربوا﴾: conjoined to ﴿كلوا﴾.
﴿هنيئا﴾: a ḥāl (circumstantial), in the accusative (manṣūb), i.e.: «مهنئين» (with enjoyment).
﴿بما﴾: the bāʾ is a preposition «للسلبية» «[Translator's note: so in the source, evidently a slip for «للسببية» (causal).]», and «ما» is maṣdar-forming (maṣdariyya) or relative; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿هنيئا﴾.
﴿أسلفتم﴾: a past verb, and the tāʾ is a pronoun in the position of a nominative (marfūʿ) as the fāʿil; the clause has no grammatical position in either case.
﴿في الأيام﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿أسلفتم﴾.
﴿الخالية﴾: a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿الأيام﴾, in the genitive (majrūr).

muyesser-irab:25-25.t:
﴿وأما﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and «أما» is a particle of condition or detailing (tafṣīl).
﴿من﴾: a relative noun in the position of a nominative (marfūʿ) as a mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿أُوتي﴾: a past verb built for the one whose agent is not named (passive).
﴿كتابه﴾: the second mafʿūl bihi (direct object), the first being the latent (mustatir) nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause ﴿أوتي﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿من﴾, with no grammatical position.
﴿بشماله﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أُتي﴾, and the hāʾ is a muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿فيقول﴾: the fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb) of ﴿أما﴾, and the clause «يقول» is the khabar (predicate) of ﴿من﴾.
﴿يا﴾: a vocative particle, the one addressed (munādā) being omitted; or [it is] merely for drawing attention.
﴿ليتني﴾: «ليت» is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh) for wishing (tamannī); the nūn is for protection (wiqāya); and the yāʾ is its noun.
﴿لم﴾: a particle of the jussive and of conversion [to the past].
﴿أُوت﴾: an imperfect verb built for the one whose agent is not named, in the jussive (majzūm), the sign of the jussive being the dropping of the weak letter; the nāʾib fāʿil is latent; the clause is in the position of a nominative as the khabar of «ليت».
﴿كتابيه﴾: the second mafʿūl bihi; the yāʾ is a muḍāf ilayhi, and the hāʾ is for the pause (hāʾ al-sakt).

muyesser-irab:26-26.t:
﴿ولم﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and «لم» is a particle of negation, of conversion [to the past] and of the jussive.
﴿أدر﴾: an imperfect verb made jussive (majzūm) by ﴿لم﴾.
﴿ما﴾: an interrogative noun in the position of a nominative (marfūʿ) as a mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿حسابيه﴾: its khabar (predicate); the yāʾ is a muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and the hāʾ is for the pause (hāʾ al-sakt); the clause stands in place of the two objects of «أدرِ», which is suspended (muʿallaq) from governing by the interrogative.

muyesser-irab:27-27.t: ﴿يا ليتها كانت القاضية﴾: the yāʾ «[Translator's note: i.e. «يا».]» is for the vocative or for drawing attention; «ليت» [and] its noun «[Translator's note: so worded in the source; i.e. «ليت» is an abrogating particle and the hāʾ is its noun.]», the pronoun referring back to the death in this world; the clause «كانت» is the khabar (predicate) of «ليت»; the noun of «كان» is a latent (mustatir) pronoun referring back to the death; and «القاضية» is the khabar of «كانت», in the accusative (manṣūb).

muyesser-irab:28-28.t:
﴿ما﴾: negating.
﴿أغنى﴾: a past verb.
﴿عنِّي﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أغنى﴾.
﴿ماليه﴾: the fāʿil (agent) of «أغنى»; the object is omitted for generalisation; and the hāʾ is for the pause (hāʾ al-sakt).
It has also been said: ﴿ما﴾ in His saying ﴿ما أغنى﴾ is interrogative, in the position of an accusative (manṣūb), standing in for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of ﴿أغنى﴾, the interrogative being for rebuke: he rebuked himself, saying: «أيَّ إغناءٍ أغنى عني مالي» (what avail has my wealth availed me?); or it is in the position of an accusative as a mafʿūl bihi (direct object), the implied form being: «أيَّ شيءٍ أغنى عني مالي» (what thing has my wealth availed me?).

muyesser-irab:29-29.t:
﴿هلك﴾: a past verb.
﴿عني﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿هلك﴾.
﴿سلطانيه﴾: the fāʿil (agent) of «هلك»; the yāʾ is in the position of a genitive (majrūr) by annexation; and the hāʾ is for the pause (hāʾ al-sakt).

muyesser-irab:30-30.t:
﴿خذوه﴾: an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil (agent), and the hāʾ is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿فغلوه﴾: conjoined to ﴿خذوه﴾; the address is to the Zabāniya appointed over the punishment. The clause «خذوه» is the object of an implied saying, and the clause of the saying is resumptive, with no grammatical position, brought to answer an implied question, as if it were said: And what is done with him after this lamentation that comes from him? And the reply was: It is said: Seize him.

muyesser-irab:31-31.t:
﴿ثم﴾: a conjunction for sequence with delay (al-tartīb maʿa al-tarākhī).
﴿الجحيم﴾: the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb indicated by the verb mentioned after it.
﴿صلوه﴾: an imperative verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its mafʿūl bihi.

muyesser-irab:32-32.t:
﴿ثم﴾: a conjunction for sequence with delay (al-tartīb maʿa al-tarākhī).
﴿في سلسلة﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿اسلكوه﴾.
﴿ذرعها﴾: a mubtadaʾ (subject), and ﴿ها﴾ is a muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿سبعون﴾: the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ.
﴿ذراعا﴾: a tamyīz (specification).
﴿فاسلكوه﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; «اسلكوه» is an imperative verb, the wāw is the fāʿil (agent), and the hāʾ is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object).

muyesser-irab:33-33.t: ﴿إنه كان لا يؤمن بالله العظيم﴾: «إنّه»: «إنّ» is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and the hāʾ is its noun; «كان» is a defective (nāqiṣ), abrogating verb, and the noun of «كان» is latent (mustatir), its implied form being «هو» (he); the clause ﴿لا يؤمن﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of «كان»; «بالله»: the bāʾ is a preposition and the Name of Majesty is a genitive noun, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يؤمن﴾; «العظيم» is an adjective (ṣifa) of «الله»; and the clause is a resumptive statement of reason (taʿlīl), so it has no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:34-34.t:
﴿ولا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and «لا» is negating.
﴿يحض﴾: an imperfect verb in the nominative (marfūʿ); its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being «هو» (he).
﴿على طعام﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يحض﴾.
﴿المسكين﴾: a muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).

muyesser-irab:35-35.t:
﴿فليس﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ that discloses an implied condition), and «ليس» is a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb.
﴿له﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate).
﴿اليوم﴾: an adverb attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), or attached to the meaning of settledness (istiqrār) contained in the khabar.
﴿ههنا﴾: «ها» is for drawing attention, and «هنا» is a demonstrative in the position of an accusative (manṣūb) as an adverb, likewise attached to what «اليوم» is attached to.
﴿حميم﴾: the noun of «ليس».

muyesser-irab:36-36.t:
﴿ولا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and «لا» is negating.
﴿طعام﴾: conjoined to «حميم».
﴿إلا﴾: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr).
﴿من غسلين﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted naʿt (adjective) of ﴿طعام﴾.

muyesser-irab:37-37.t:
﴿لا﴾: negating.
﴿يأكله﴾: an imperfect verb, and the hāʾ is a fronted mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿إلا﴾: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr).
﴿الخاطئون﴾: the fāʿil (agent) of «يأكله», made nominative (marfūʿ) by the wāw.

muyesser-irab:38-38.t:
﴿فلا﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya), and «لا» is redundant (ṣila).
﴿أُقسم﴾: an imperfect verb; its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being «أنا» (I).
﴿بما﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أقسم﴾.
﴿تبصرون﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause ﴿تبصرون﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. The clause ﴿فلا أقسم﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:39-39.t:
﴿وما﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; «ما» is relative, conjoined to the preceding ﴿ما﴾, in the position of a genitive (majrūr).
﴿لا﴾: negating.
﴿تبصرون﴾: an imperfect verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); the clause ﴿لا تبصرون﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:40-40.t:
﴿إنه﴾: «إن» is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and the hāʾ is its noun.
﴿لقول﴾: the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), and «قول» is the khabar (predicate) of «إن».
﴿رسول﴾: a muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿كريم﴾: an adjective (ṣifa) of ﴿رسول﴾; the clause has no grammatical position, because it is the answer to the oath.

muyesser-irab:41-41.t:
﴿وما﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and ﴿ما﴾ is the Ḥijāzī negating [«ما»], which governs as «ليس» does.
﴿هو﴾: the noun of «ما».
﴿بقول﴾: the bāʾ is a redundant (ṣila) preposition, and ﴿قول﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of the Ḥijāzī ﴿ما﴾, accusative in position and made genitive (majrūr) in form by the bāʾ.
﴿شاعر﴾: a muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿قليلا﴾: it stands in for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), because it is an adjective of the omitted maṣdar, i.e.: «تؤمنون إيمانًا قليلًا» (you believe with little belief).
﴿ما﴾: redundant (ṣila), to emphasise the littleness.
﴿تؤمنون﴾: a verb and its fāʿil (agent). The clause ﴿تؤمنون﴾ is parenthetical, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:42-42.t:
﴿ولا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and ﴿لا﴾ is redundant (ṣila), to emphasise the negation.
﴿بقول كاهن﴾: conjoined to ﴿بقول شاعر﴾, and «كاهن» is a muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿قليلا﴾: it stands in for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), because it is an adjective of the omitted maṣdar, i.e.: «تتذكرون تذكرًا قليلًا» (you take heed with little heed).
﴿ما﴾: redundant (ṣila), to emphasise the littleness.
﴿تذكرون﴾: a verb and its fāʿil (agent). The clause ﴿تذكرون﴾ is parenthetical, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:43-43.t:
﴿تنزيل﴾: the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e.: «هو تنزيل» (it is a revelation).
﴿من رب﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿تنزيل﴾.
﴿العالمين﴾: a muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).

muyesser-irab:44-44.t:
﴿ولو﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and «لو» is conditional.
﴿تقوَّل﴾: a past verb, and its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir).
﴿علينا﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿تقول﴾.
﴿بعض﴾: it stands in for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object).
﴿الأقاويل﴾: a muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).

muyesser-irab:45-45.t:
﴿لأخذنا﴾: the lām occurs in the apodosis (jawāb) of ﴿لو﴾; ﴿أخذنا﴾ is a past verb, and ﴿نا﴾ is the fāʿil (agent).
﴿منه﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أخذ﴾.
﴿باليمين﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); the clause has no grammatical position, [being] the apodosis of a non-jussive condition.

muyesser-irab:46-46.t:
﴿ثم﴾: a conjunction for sequence with delay (al-tartīb maʿa al-tarākhī).
﴿لقطعنا﴾: conjoined to ﴿أخذنا﴾.
﴿منه﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿قطعنا﴾, or to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿الوتين﴾: a mafʿūl bihi (direct object), in the accusative (manṣūb), the sign of its being accusative being the overt fatḥa.

muyesser-irab:47-47.t:
﴿فما﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and ﴿ما﴾ is the Ḥijāzī negating [«ما»], which governs as «ليس» does.
﴿منكم﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from ﴿أحد﴾.
﴿من﴾: a redundant (ṣila) preposition.
﴿أحد﴾: the noun of ﴿ما﴾, nominative (marfūʿ) in position and made genitive (majrūr) in form by ﴿من﴾.
﴿عنه﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿حاجزين﴾.
﴿حاجزين﴾: the khabar (predicate) of the Ḥijāzī ﴿ما﴾, in the accusative (manṣūb).

muyesser-irab:48-48.t:
﴿وإنه﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; «إن» is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh); and the hāʾ is an indeclinable (mabnī) pronoun in the position of an accusative (manṣūb) as the noun of «إن». The statement is conjoined to the preceding answer to the oath, so it is part of that which is sworn by (al-maqsūm bihi) «[Translator's note: so in the source; as part of the answer to the oath it belongs to what is sworn to (al-muqsam ʿalayhi).]».
﴿لتذكرة﴾: the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), and «تذكرة» is the khabar (predicate) of «إن».
﴿للمتقين﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿تذكرة﴾.

nahhas-irab:2-3.t:
مَا الْحَاقَّةُ (2): a mubtadaʾ (subject) and its khabar (predicate), and together they are the khabar of «الحاقّة»; it carries the sense of magnifying. The implied form is:
"al-ḥāqqa, what is it?" — but repeating the noun is more majestic. Likewise وَما أَدْراكَ مَا الْحَاقَّةُ (3).

nahhas-irab:4-4.t: عادٌ takes tanwīn because it is light; ثَمُودُ does not take tanwīn when taken as the name of the tribe, and takes tanwīn when taken as the name of the clan. Qatāda said: «بالقارعة», i.e. the Hour. Someone else said: because it strikes (taqraʿu) people's hearts by coming upon them suddenly.

nahhas-irab:5-6.t:
Qatāda said: Allah, Mighty and Majestic, sent upon them a shout which destroyed them [Translator's note: the text has «فأهدتهم», evidently a misprint for «فأهلكتهم» "destroyed them"]. It has been said: they were destroyed by their transgression; and it has been said: by the transgressing group. Abū Jaʿfar said: the view of Qatāda is the soundest of them: Allah informed of the means by which He destroyed them, not of the cause for which He destroyed them, just as He informed in the story of ʿĀd, saying, exalted be His praise:
وَأَمَّا عادٌ فَأُهْلِكُوا بِرِيحٍ صَرْصَرٍ: Qatāda said: that is, cold; someone else said: that is, loud-sounding. عاتِيَةٍ: exceeding the measure of its blowing.

nahhas-irab:7-7.t: وَثَمانِيَةَ: the hāʾ in «ثمانية» is [a mark of the] feminine, and it was dropped from «سبع» to distinguish between masculine and feminine. حُسُوماً: the soundest thing said about it is "consecutive", because it is soundly reported from Ibn Masʿūd and Ibn ʿAbbās; «وحسوم» is a naʿt (adjective). Whoever says its meaning is "following in succession" takes it as a maṣdar (verbal noun). فَتَرَى الْقَوْمَ فِيها صَرْعى: in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial). كَأَنَّهُمْ أَعْجازُ نَخْلٍ: Qatāda said: the roots of palm trees. Someone else said: as though they were the lower parts of palm trees, eaten away, hollowed out and scattered. خاوِيَةٍ: according to the feminine of «نخل».

nahhas-irab:8-8.t: That is, of a remaining group; and it has been said: of remaining (a maṣdar).

nahhas-irab:9-9.t:
وَجاءَ فِرْعَوْنُ وَمَنْ قَبْلَهُ [i.e. «ومن قِبَلَه», "and those with him"] [Translator's note: the vowelled text reproduces the standard reading; the reading described first is «قِبَلَه»]
is the reading of al-Ḥasan, Abū Rajāʾ, ʿĀṣim al-Jaḥdarī, Abū ʿAmr and al-Kisāʾī, and it is the choice of Abū ʿUbayd; the reading of Abū Jaʿfar, Shayba, Nāfiʿ, Ibn Kathīr, al-Aʿmash and Ḥamza is وَمَنْ قَبْلَهُ ("and those before him"). Both are accusative as adverbs (ẓarf). Al-Ḥasan said: «ومن قبله» means "and those with him". Abū ʿUbayd rejected whoever read «ومن قبله» [i.e. «قبله»], because there were believers among them.
Abū Jaʿfar said: this is not binding, because the meaning is known from His saying, Mighty and Majestic: وَالْمُؤْتَفِكاتُ بِالْخاطِئَةِ.

nahhas-irab:11-11.t: Figurative (majāz), because «الجارية» (the ship) is the ship of Nūḥ ﷺ, and only the forefathers of those addressed by this were carried in it, so they were as though they had been carried with them.

nahhas-irab:12-12.t:
لِنَجْعَلَها لَكُمْ تَذْكِرَةً:
Qatāda said: the ship remained as an admonition, a sign and a reminder until the first generations of this community saw it. وَتَعِيَها:
that is, the reminder. It is reported from ʿĀṣim that he read «وتعيّها» [with a doubled yāʾ],
and that is a solecism (laḥn), because it is from «وعى يعي». From Ṭalḥa, that he read «وتعيها» with the ʿayn quiescent [«وتعيَها»], dropping the kasra because of its heaviness; it is like أَرِنِي [al-Baqara: 260 and al-Aʿrāf: 143]. أُذُنٌ واعِيَةٌ:
One says «أُذْن» [as well as «أُذُن»]; it is feminine, and its diminutive is «أُذَيْنة».

nahhas-irab:13-13.t: نَفْخَةٌ واحِدَةٌ: since the maṣdar (verbal noun) is qualified by a naʿt (adjective), its being nominative [as nāʾib fāʿil, deputy agent] is good; if it were not qualified, it would be accusative and nothing else.

nahhas-irab:14-14.t: Because they are two plurals; if «فدُكِكْنَ» or «فدُكَّتْ» were said in ordinary speech, it would be permissible.

nahhas-irab:17-17.t: وَالْمَلَكُ عَلى أَرْجائِها: that is, on the sides of the sky. «الرجا» (side) is shortened (maqṣūr) and written with alif, while «الرجاء» (hope) is lengthened (mamdūd). وَالْمَلَكُ is in the sense of "the angels", as is shown to you by وَيَحْمِلُ عَرْشَ رَبِّكَ فَوْقَهُمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ ثَمانِيَةٌ. Al-Suddī reported from Abū Mālik, from Ibn ʿAbbās, who said: eight ranks whose number none knows but Allah, Mighty and Majestic; al-Ḍaḥḥāk said likewise. Ibn Isḥāq and Ibn Zayd said: eight angels, while today they are four.

nahhas-irab:18-18.t:
According to the feminine of the word; the reading of the Kufans is «يخفى» [masculine],
because it is a non-real feminine, and there is a separation between it and its verb.

nahhas-irab:19-21.t:
فَأَمَّا مَنْ أُوتِيَ كِتابَهُ بِيَمِينِهِ:
nominative as a mubtadaʾ (subject), and its khabar (predicate) is فَيَقُولُ هاؤُمُ اقْرَؤُا كِتابِيَهْ. Some of the lexicographers said: the origin is «هاؤم», then [the hamza] was substituted for the kāf. Ibn [Abī] Ṭalḥa reported from Ibn ʿAbbās: إِنِّي ظَنَنْتُ أَنِّي مُلاقٍ حِسابِيَهْ (20): he said:
I was certain. فَهُوَ فِي عِيشَةٍ راضِيَةٍ (21): by way of attribution (nasab), i.e. possessing contentment.

nahhas-irab:22-22.t: A badal (substitute), with the preposition repeated.

nahhas-irab:23-23.t: Shuʿba reported from Abū Isḥāq, from al-Barāʾ, who said: he eats of its fruits while standing.

nahhas-irab:24-24.t: These are the days of the world; from «خلا», when it has passed.

nahhas-irab:25-25.t: Some of the Arabs say «ليتني», dropping the nūn, just as they drop it in «إن» [Translator's note: the text prints «ليتني»; the form meant, without the nūn, is «ليتني»].

nahhas-irab:26-26.t: With the hāʾ kept in pausal form, and likewise «ما» [i.e. in «ماليه»], to show the vowel. Keeping it in continuous reading (waṣl) is a solecism (laḥn), not permissible according to any of the scholars of Arabic that I know of. Whoever follows the written text (al-sawād) and wants to be safe from solecism pauses on it, and so is correct on both counts.

nahhas-irab:27-28.t:
يا لَيْتَها كانَتِ الْقاضِيَةَ: the noun (ism) of «كان» is latent in it; the tāʾ is not a noun, it is only a sign of the feminine.
ما أَغْنى عَنِّي مالِيَهْ: «ما» is in the position of the accusative by «أغنى»; it may also be negative, having no position.

nahhas-irab:30-31.t: ثُمَّ الْجَحِيمَ صَلُّوهُ (31): it is permissible to keep the wāw according to the original; whoever drops it does so because the wāw is quiescent, and the hāʾ is not an impervious barrier.

nahhas-irab:32-34.t:
ثُمَّ فِي سِلْسِلَةٍ ذَرْعُها سَبْعُونَ ذِراعاً فَاسْلُكُوهُ (32) إِنَّهُ كانَ لا يُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ الْعَظِيمِ (33) وَلا يَحُضُّ عَلى طَعامِ الْمِسْكِينِ (34): «الذراع» (cubit) is feminine, as the poet said:
497- وهي ثلاث أذرع وإصبع
(And it is three cubits and a finger's breadth.)
Al-Farrāʾ reported
that some of ʿUkl make it masculine, and others have reported that too. إِنَّهُ كانَ لا يُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ الْعَظِيمِ (33): in the position of the accusative, and nominative because it is an imperfect verb; likewise وَلا يَحُضُّ عَلى طَعامِ الْمِسْكِينِ (34).

nahhas-irab:35-35.t: Abū Zayd said: «الحميم» in the speech of the Arabs is the near relative.

nahhas-irab:36-36.t: It may be an exception from the first.

nahhas-irab:37-37.t: The reading of Mūsā ibn Ṭalḥa is إِلَّا الْخاطِؤُنَ [i.e. «الخاطئون»], by substituting for the hamza; this is an anomalous dialect form.

nahhas-irab:38-39.t: وَما لا تُبْصِرُونَ (39): «لا» is redundant (zāʾida), for emphasis.

nahhas-irab:40-40.t: It has been said: it is figurative (majāz), because the Messenger ﷺ heard it from Him.

nahhas-irab:41-42.t: قَلِيلًا is accusative because it is a naʿt (adjective) of a maṣdar (verbal noun) or of an adverb (ẓarf), and likewise وَلا بِقَوْلِ كاهِنٍ قَلِيلًا ما تَذَكَّرُونَ.

nahhas-irab:43-43.t: تَنْزِيلٌ مِنْ رَبِّ الْعالَمِينَ (43): by an implied mubtadaʾ (subject).

nahhas-irab:45-45.t: There are two views on its meaning. One of them: by force. The other: We would humiliate him, as you say "take him by the hand and make him stand up".

nahhas-irab:46-46.t: So Allah, Mighty and Majestic, informed of His ruling regarding His friends and those dear to Him, so that others might take heed.

nahhas-irab:47-47.t: A naʿt (adjective) of «أحد», according to the meaning.

nahhas-irab:50-50.t: That is, they will feel regret on the Day of Resurrection for having abandoned faith in it.

nahhas-irab:51-51.t: That is, its pure essence. The Kufans say: this is the annexation of a thing to itself.

nahhas-irab:52-52.t: That is, declare Him transcendent and free of what has been ascribed to Him of rivals, children and likenesses. «العظيم»: the One before whom everything is small.

safi-cedvel:38-52.t:
* I'rab:
(الفاء) resumptive; (لا) redundant (zāʾida) [Note: Or it is the lā of generic negation (lā al-nāfiya li-l-jins), what it negates being implied (muqaddar), i.e. there is no rejecting their denial of the resurrection; then the oath begins anew.], (بما) attached to (mutaʿalliq) (أقسم), the returning pronoun being omitted; (الواو) conjunction; (ما) the second is in the position of a genitive (majrūr), conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the first ما; (لا) negative; (اللام) in the position of the lām of the oath; (الواو) conjunction; (ما) negative, operating like laysa; (قول) genitive in form, accusative (manṣūb) in position, khabar (predicate) of ما; (قليلا) mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), standing in for the maṣdar (verbal noun), being its adjective; (ما) redundant, to emphasise the paucity ...
The clause «لا أقسم ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «تبصرون ...» has no grammatical position: ṣila (relative clause) of the first relative.
The clause «لا تبصرون ...» has no grammatical position: ṣila of the second relative (ما).
The clause «إنّه لقول ...» has no grammatical position: the answer of the oath. The clause «ما هو بقول ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the answer of the oath. The clause «تؤمنون ...» has no grammatical position: parenthetical.
42-43 (الواو) conjunction; (لا) redundant, to emphasise the negation; (بقول) like the first, and conjoined to it; (قليلا ما) like the first; (تذكّرون) imperfect verb from which one of the two tāʾs has been omitted; (تنزيل) khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), its implied form being "هو"; (من ربّ) attached to (تنزيل) ...
The clause «تذكّرون» has no grammatical position: a second parenthesis.
The clause «(هو) تنزيل ...» has no grammatical position: an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī).
44-47 (الواو) conjunction — or resumptive; (لو) a non-jussivising conditional particle; (علينا) attached to (تقوّل); (بعض) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative; (اللام) occurring in the answer of لو; (منه) attached to (أخذنا) by its being made to include the meaning of «نلنا»; (باليمين) attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the agent of أخذنا [Note: I.e. We would seize him while being strong; اليمين is used metaphorically for strength.]; (ثمّ) conjunction; (لقطعنا) like لأخذنا; (منه) attached to (قطعنا) [Note: Or attached to a ḥāl of الوتين.]; (الفاء) conjunction; (ما) negative, operating like laysa; (منكم) attached to a ḥāl of أحد; (أحد) genitive in form, nominative (marfūʿ) in position, the noun of ما; (عنه) attached to (حاجزين), the khabar of ما, and this is with the omission of a muḍāf, i.e. «عن عقابه» [Note: The pronoun in (عنه) refers to the Prophet ﷺ.] ...
The clause «تقوّل ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the answer of the oath [Note: Or it is resumptive.].
The clause «أخذنا ...» has no grammatical position: the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussivising condition.
The clause «قطعنا ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the apodosis clause.
The clause «ما منكم من أحد ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the apodosis clause.
48-51 (الواو) conjunction in the four places [Note: Or the first is resumptive and the other three are conjunctions.]; (اللام) the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), for emphasis, in the four places; (للمتّقين) attached to (تذكرة); (منكم) attached to the khabar of أنّ; (على الكافرين) attached to a naʿt (adjective) of (حسرة) ...
The interpreted maṣdar (أنّ منكم مكذّبين) is in the position of an accusative, standing in place of the two objects of نعلم.
The clause «إنّه لتذكرة ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause of the answer of the oath [Note: Or it is resumptive, and the following clauses are conjoined to it.].
The clause «إنّا لنعلم ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause إنّه لتذكرة.
The clause «نعلم ...» is in the position of a nominative, khabar of إنّ. The clause «إنّه لحسرة ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause إنّه لتذكرة.
The clause «إنّه لحق ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause إنّه لتذكرة.
52- (الفاء) linking to the answer of an implied condition; (باسم) attached to (سبّح) [Note: Or the bāʾ is redundant and اسم is accusative in position, a mafʿūl bihi whose governor is سبّح.] ...
The clause «سبّح ...» is in the position of the answer of an implied condition.

* Morphology:
(الوتين): a noun for a vein in the heart through which blood runs to the whole body; its pattern is فعيل, with fatḥa on the fāʾ.

safi-cedvel:1-8.t:
* I'rab:
(ما) an interrogative noun in the position of nominative as a second mubtadaʾ (subject), whose khabar (predicate) is the second (الحاقّة).
The clause «الحاقّة ما الحاقّة» has no grammatical position: initial (ibtidāʾiyya).
The clause «ما الحاقّة ...» is in the position of nominative as khabar of the first mubtadaʾ (الحاقّة).
3- (الواو) conjunction; (ما) like the first, its khabar being the clause أدراك; (ما الحاقّة) like the first, repeated for magnification and exaltation.
The clause «ما أدراك ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the initial clause.
The clause «أدراك ...» is in the position of nominative as khabar of the second mubtadaʾ (ما).
The clause «ما الحاقّة ...» is in the position of accusative as the second mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of the verb أدراك.
4- (الواو) conjunction; (بالقارعة) attached to (mutaʿalliq) (كذّبت).
The clause «كذّبت ثمود ...» has no grammatical position: an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī), to establish the states of al-Ḥāqqa.
5- 6 (الفاء) a conjunction of consequence (tafrīʿiyya); (أمّا) a particle of condition and detailing; the second (الفاء) linking the apodosis of أمّا; (الواو) in (أهلكوا) is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); (بالطاغية) attached to (أهلكوا), and (الباء) is causal ...; (بريح) attached to the second (أهلكوا) ...
The clause «ثمود ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause كذّبت ثمود ...
The clause «أهلكوا ...» is in the position of nominative as khabar of the mubtadaʾ (ثمود) [Note: The basis of this clause: whatever the case may be, Thamūd were destroyed by the overwhelming blast.].
The clause «أمّا عاد ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause أمّا ثمود ...
The clause «أهلكوا ...» is in the position of nominative as khabar of the mubtadaʾ (عاد).
7- (عليهم) attached to (سخّرها); (سبع) an accusative adverb, attached to (سخّرها); (حسوما) a naʿt (adjective) of سبع and ثمانية [Note: It may be a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the object of سخّرها ... and if الحسوم is taken to be a maṣdar — like الشكور with ḍamma on the shīn — it is a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object).]; (الفاء) resumptive; (فيها) attached to (ترى); (صرعى) an accusative ḥāl, the sign of the accusative being the implied (muqaddar) fatḥa.
The clause «سخّرها ...» is in the position of genitive as a naʿt of ريح [Note: Or in the position of accusative as a ḥāl of ريح, because it has become specified by the description ... it may also be resumptive.].
The clause «ترى ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «كأنّهم أعجاز ...» is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl of القوم.
8- (الفاء) conjunction; (هل) an interrogative particle — and it may convey negation; (لهم) attached to a ḥāl of باقية; (باقية) genitive in form, accusative in position, as mafʿūl bihi [Note: It is a naʿt of an omitted qualified noun ... and the tāʾ may be for intensiveness.] ...
The clause «هل ترى ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause ترى القوم.

* Morphology:
(1) الحاقّة: active participle of the triliteral حقّ, to which the tāʾ of the feminine was added because a feminine is described by it, i.e. the Resurrection that is inevitable, or the Hour that is inevitable, or the state in which matters become binding and their reality is known. Its pattern is فاعلة.
(3) أدراك: it contains iʿlāl (weak-letter change) by substitution; its original form is أدري — with a yāʾ at its end; the yāʾ was vowelled after a fatḥa, so it was changed into alif.
(5) الطاغية: active participle of the triliteral طغى, as in "the thing exceeded (طغى) its limit"; it is a description standing in for the described noun, i.e. the transgressing shout or the transgressing deed. Its pattern is فاعلة ... It was said that it is a maṣdar, and (التاء) is for intensiveness, as in الداهية; and it may be meant as the one who hamstrung the she-camel, who was called طاغية just as one says "so-and-so is a راوية (great narrator)" or "a داهية (cunning one)".
(6) عاتية: feminine of عات, active participle of the triliteral عتا يعتو. Its pattern is فاع; its lām was deleted because it is a manqūṣ (noun ending in -ī) ...
(7) سبع: it came masculine because the thing counted is feminine, namely ليال ... see verse (23) of Sūrat al-Kahf.
(ثمانية): it came feminine because the thing counted is masculine, namely أيام ... a noun of number. Its pattern is فعاللة.
(حسوما): plural of حاسم, active participle of حسم, meaning to follow up an action time after time, especially a complete succession. Some made it a maṣdar meaning severance or extirpation. Its pattern is فعول with two ḍammas.
(صرعى): plural of صريع, a ṣifa mushabbaha (assimilated adjective) from the passive صرع; it is فعيل in the sense of مفعول, like قتيل and قتلى. The pattern of صرعى is فعلى with fatḥa then sukūn.

* Rhetoric:
(1) The meaning of the interrogative: in His words «مَا الْحَاقَّةُ».
I.e.: what thing has made you know what it is? — as an emphasis of its terror and awfulness, by showing that it lies outside the circle of the knowledge of created beings, meaning that its affair is so great, and the extent of its terror and severity such, that hardly anyone's understanding or imagination can reach it. [Translator's note: the source prints «ولا دهمه»; «ولا وهمه» ("nor his imagination") appears intended and is translated.] However you estimate its state, it is beyond that, and greater, and greater still.
The overt noun has been put in the place of the pronoun, for He did not say: ما هي. The benefit of this is an increase in the terror and the magnification of its affair.
2- Al-majāz al-mursal (non-metaphorical figure): in His words «وَثَمانِيَةَ أَيَّامٍ حُسُوماً».
حسوما is the plural of حاسم, like شهود the plural of شاهد, from "I cauterised (حسمت) the animal" when you follow up its cauterisation of the ailment time after time until it is cut off (ينحسم). So it is a majāz mursal, by using the restricted — namely الحسم, which is successive cauterisation — for succession in general. And it was said: it is borrowed from الحسم in the sense of cauterisation; the days are likened to the cauteriser, and the wind, because of its connection with them and its blowing in them.
3- The non-specified simile (al-tashbīh al-mursal): in His words «كَأَنَّهُمْ أَعْجازُ نَخْلٍ خاوِيَةٍ».
He likened them to trunks because of the tallness of their statures, for the wind would cut off their heads as it cuts off the heads of tall palms during those eight days.

safi-cedvel:9-10.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive, and the other two are conjunctions; (من) a relative noun in the position of nominative, conjoined (maʿṭūf) to فرعون; (قبله) an adverb of time, accusative, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ṣila (relative clause) of من; (المؤتفكات) conjoined to فرعون, nominative [Note: This is figurative, or with a muḍāf omitted, i.e. the people of the overturned cities.]; (بالخاطئة) attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil (agent) of جاء and what is conjoined to it.
The clause «جاء فرعون ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
10- (الفاء) conjunction; (عصوا) a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the alif, which was deleted because of the meeting of two quiescent letters; (أخذة) a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), accusative.
The clause «عصوا ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the resumptive clause.
The clause «أخذهم ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause عصوا.

* Morphology:
(الخاطئة): a form of relation (nisba), i.e. possessed of error, like تامر and لابن. Its pattern is فاعلة.
(أخذة): a maṣdar of single occurrence (maṣdar marra) from the triliteral أخذ. Its pattern is فعلة with fatḥa then sukūn.

safi-cedvel:11-12.t:
* I'rab:
(لمّا) an adverb in the sense of "when", containing the meaning of condition, in the position of accusative, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the apodosis حملناكم; (في الجارية) attached to (حملناكم) [Note: I.e. We carried your forefathers ... so the speech has a muḍāf omitted.].
The clause «إنّا ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «الشرط وفعله وجوابه ...» (the condition, its protasis and its apodosis) is in the position of nominative as khabar (predicate) of إنّ.
The clause «طغا الماء ...» is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi. The clause «حملناكم ...» has no grammatical position: apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition.
12- (اللام) of purpose (taʿlīl); (نجعلها) an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied أن after the lām; (لكم) attached to an omitted second mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
The interpreted maṣdar (أن نجعلها ...) is in the position of genitive by the lām, attached to (حملناكم).
The clause «نجعلها ...» has no grammatical position: ṣila (relative clause) of the implied particle relative (أن).
The clause «تعيها أذن ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause نجعلها.

* Morphology:
(12) تعيها: it contains iʿlāl (weak-letter change) by deletion; the fāʾ was deleted in the imperfect because it is a separated lafīf weak verb (lafīf mafrūq), which is treated like the mithāl in iʿlāl, just as it is treated like the nāqiṣ in the imperative. Its pattern is تعلها.
(واعية): feminine of واع, active participle of the triliteral وعى. Its pattern is فاع, and it contains iʿlāl by deletion: the lām was deleted because it is a manqūṣ (noun ending in -ī). The pattern of واعية is فاعلة.

* Rhetoric:
1- Representative metaphor (al-istiʿāra al-tamthīliyya): in His words «إِنَّا لَمَّا طَغَى الْماءُ حَمَلْناكُمْ فِي الْجارِيَةِ».
This metaphor is of the type of borrowing the intelligible for the sensible, because of sharing in an intelligible matter; it is the metaphor compounded of the dense and the subtle. The thing borrowed is transgression (al-ṭughā), which is objectionable self-exaltation; the thing borrowed from is every self-exalting, arrogant, tyrannical, harmful one; and the thing borrowed for is the water. Transgression is intelligible, the water is sensible, and the thing borrowed from is sensible.
2- Indefiniteness (al-tankīr): in His words «أُذُنٌ واعِيَةٌ».
He said أذن واعية, in the singular and indefinite, to announce that those who retain are few among them, to rebuke people for the fewness of those among them who retain, and to indicate that a single ear, if it retains and understands from Allah, is the great majority in the sight of Allah, and that no regard is paid to those besides it, even if they fill what lies between east and west

safi-cedvel:13-18.t:
* I'rab:
(الفاء) resumptive; (في الصور) attached to (mutaʿalliq) (نفخ); (نفخة) a maṣdar standing in place of the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), because it is qualified.
The clause «نفخ ... نفخة» is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
14- 15 (الواو) conjunction in both places, and likewise (الفاء); (دكّة) a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), accusative; (الفاء) linking the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); (يومئذ) an adverb annexed to an adverb, indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa — because it is annexed to an indeclinable — or accusative as a badal (substitute) of إذا, i.e. attached to (وقعت); and the tanwīn in it is a substitute for an omitted clause, i.e.: on the day when the Trumpet is blown ...
The clause «حملت الأرض ...» is in the position of genitive, conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause نفخ.
The clause «دكّتا ...» is in the position of genitive, conjoined to the clause حملت الأرض.
The clause «وقعت الواقعة ...» has no grammatical position: apodosis of a non-jussive condition.
16- (الواو) conjunction, and likewise (الفاء); the second (يومئذ) attached to (واهية).
The clause «انشقّت السماء ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the apodosis.
The clause «هي ... واهية ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause انشقت السماء.
17- 18 (الواو) conjunction — or circumstantial (ḥāliyya) — and the second is a conjunction; (فوقهم) an accusative adverb, attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of ثمانية [Note: A naʿt (adjective) placed before what it qualifies. There is disagreement about what ثمانية counts: it was said eight ranks, and it was said eight angels, and it was said eight thousand ... Or it is attached to a ḥāl of عرش ربّك.]; (يومئذ) like the first, attached to (يحمل), and the next one attached to (تعرضون), the pronoun in which is the nāʾib fāʿil; (لا) negative; (منكم) attached to a ḥāl of خافية — a naʿt placed before what it qualifies.
The clause «الملك على أرجائها ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause انشقّت السماء [Note: Or in the position of accusative as a ḥāl of السماء.].
The clause «يحمل ثمانية ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause الملك على أرجائها.
The clause «تعرضون ...» has no grammatical position: an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī) [Note: Or it is a badal of the apodosis.].
The clause «لا تخفى منكم خافية» is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl of the pronoun in (تعرضون).

* Morphology:
(13) نفخة: a maṣdar of single occurrence (maṣdar marra) from the triliteral نفخ. Its pattern is فعلة with fatḥa then sukūn.
(14) دكّة: a maṣdar of single occurrence from the triliteral دكّ. Its pattern is فعلة with fatḥa then sukūn.
(16) واهية: feminine of الواهي, active participle of the triliteral وهي. Its pattern is فاعلة, meaning weak.
(17) أرجاء: plural of رجا, meaning edge and side; in it the wāw was changed into hamza because it came final after a quiescent alif; its original form is أرجاو ... Its pattern is أفعال.
(18) خافية: feminine of الخافي, active participle of the triliteral خفي. Its pattern is فاعلة ... or it is a noun meaning the hidden thing, the opposite of the openly declared ... or it is a maṣdar meaning hiddenness, the opposite of openness, like العافية.

safi-cedvel:19-37.t:
* I'rab:
(الفاء) resumptive, and the second one linking the apodosis of أمّا; (أمّا) a particle of condition and detailing; (بيمينه) attached to (mutaʿalliq) (أوتي), and (الباء) is instrumental (li-l-istiʿāna); (هاؤم) a verbal noun of command (ism fiʿl amr) meaning "take", its fāʿil (agent) being a latent (mustatir) pronoun, implied as أنتم; (كتابيه) a mafʿūl bihi (direct object) governed by اقرؤوا [Note: It is also the object of (هاؤم) by way of contention (tanāzuʿ), and the pronoun of the book has been implied in it.], accusative, the sign of the accusative being the fatḥa implied (muqaddar) on the letter before the yāʾ, and (الياء) is muḍāf ilayhi, and (الهاء) is the hāʾ of pausing (hāʾ al-sakt), having no grammatical position ... [Translator's note: the source prints «المقدّة», a misprint for «المقدّرة» ("implied"), which is translated.]
The clause «أمّا من أوتي ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive ...
The clause «أوتي ...» has no grammatical position: ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (من).
The clause «يقول ...» is in the position of nominative as khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject) (من).
The clause «هاؤم ...» is in the position of accusative as the object of speech (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «اقرؤوا ...» is in the position of accusative as a badal (substitute) of the clause هاؤم [Note: Or it is an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī) with no grammatical position.].
20- (ملاق) the khabar of أنّ, nominative, the sign of the nominative being the ḍamma implied on the deleted yāʾ, for it is a manqūṣ noun (ending in -ī); (حسابيه) mafʿūl bihi of the active participle ملاق, and it is like كتابيه ...
The clause «إنّي ظننت ...» has no grammatical position: a resumption within the scope of the saying.
The clause «ظننت ...» is in the position of nominative as khabar of إنّ.
The interpreted maṣdar (أنّي ملاق ...) is in the position of accusative, filling the place of the two objects of ظنّ.
21- 23 (الفاء) resumptive; (في عيشة) attached to the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (هو); (في جنّة) attached to the omitted khabar [Note: Or attached to عيشة.] ...
The clause «هو في عيشة ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «قطوفها دانية ...» is in the position of genitive as a naʿt (adjective) of جنّة.
24- (هنيئا) an accusative ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil of كلوا and اشربوا; (ما) an infinitival particle [Note: Or a relative noun in the position of genitive, with the referent pronoun omitted.]; (في الأيام) attached to (أسلفتم).
The clause «كلوا ...» is in the position of accusative as the object of speech of an implied saying.
The clause «اشربوا ...» is in the position of accusative, conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause كلوا.
The clause «أسلفتم ...» has no grammatical position: ṣila of the particle relative (ما).
The interpreted maṣdar (ما أسفلتم ...) is in the position of genitive by the bāʾ, attached to (كلوا واشربوا). [Translator's note: the source prints «أسفلتم» here, a misprint for «أسلفتم» of the verse.]
25- (الواو) conjunction; (أمّا من ... فيقول) like the first; (يا) a particle for drawing attention (tanbīh); (كتابيه) like the first [Note: In verse (19) of this sūra.] ...
The clause «أمّا من أوتي ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause من أوتي (the first).
The clause «أوتي ...» has no grammatical position: ṣila of the relative (من).
The clause «يقول ...» is in the position of nominative as khabar of the mubtadaʾ (من).
The clause «ليتني لم أوت ...» is in the position of accusative as the object of speech.
The clause «لم أوت ...» is in the position of nominative as khabar of ليتني.
26- 27 (الواو) conjunction; (ما) an interrogative noun in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ, whose khabar is (حسابيه), nominative, the sign of the nominative being the ḍamma implied on the letter before the yāʾ of the first person, and (الياء) is muḍāf ilayhi, and (الهاء) is for pausing (li-l-sakt), having no grammatical position; (يا) for drawing attention; and the third-person pronoun in (ليتها) refers to the first death.
The clause «لم أدر ...» is in the position of nominative, conjoined to the clause لم أوت.
The clause «ما حسابيه» is in the position of accusative, filling the place of the two objects of أدر, which is suspended (muʿallaq) by the interrogative (ما).
The clause «ليتها كانت القاضية» has no grammatical position: a resumption within the scope of the saying.
The clause «كانت القاضية» is in the position of nominative as khabar of ليتها.
28- 29 (ما) negative [Note: Or an interrogative, a fronted mafʿūl bihi.]; (عنّي) attached to (أغنى), and the second one attached to (هلك) by its being made to carry (taḍmīn) the meaning of غاب "has vanished" ...
The clause «ما أغنى عنّي ماليه» has no grammatical position: an explanatory resumption — or causal (taʿlīliyya). The clause «هلك عنّي سلطانية» has no grammatical position: another explanatory resumption — or another causal explanation.
30- 31 (الفاء) conjunction, and likewise (ثمّ); (الجحيم) a second mafʿūl bihi, fronted ...
The clause «خذوه ...» is in the position of accusative as the object of speech of an implied saying.
The clause «غلّوه ...» is in the position of accusative, conjoined to the clause خذوه.
The clause «صلّوه ...» is in the position of accusative, conjoined to the clause خذوه.
32- (ثمّ) conjunction; (في سلسلة) attached to (أسلكوه); (ذراعا) tamyīz (specification), accusative; (الفاء) conjunction [Note: For conjoining the reported clauses in the i'rab of the clauses.] ...
The clause «ذرعها سبعون ...» is in the position of genitive as a naʿt of سلسلة.
The clause «أسلكوه ...» is in the position of accusative, conjoined to an implied clause after ثمّ [Note: The implied clause is conjoined to the clause (صلّوه) by (ثمّ), i.e. then increase his punishment, so insert him into a chain ...].
33- 34 (لا) negative; (بالله) attached to the negated (يؤمن); (الواو) conjunction; (لا) negative; (على طعام) attached to (يحضّ).
The clause «إنّه كان ...» has no grammatical position: causal — or an explanatory resumption.
The clause «كان لا يؤمن ...» is in the position of nominative as khabar of إنّ.
The clause «لا يؤمن بالله ...» is in the position of accusative as khabar of كان.
The clause «لا يحضّ ...» is in the position of accusative, conjoined to the clause لا يؤمن.
35- 37 (الفاء) linking the apodosis of an implied condition; (له) attached to an omitted khabar of ليس [Note: Or attached to a ḥāl of حميم, the adverb (هاهنا) being the khabar of ليس.]; (اليوم) an adverb of time, accusative, attached to a ḥāl of حميم, and likewise (هاهنا) [Note: Or (هاهنا) is the khabar of ليس.]; (الواو) conjunction; (لا) redundant (zāʾida), to emphasise the negation; (طعام) conjoined to حميم, nominative; (إلّا) for restriction (ḥaṣr); (من غسلين) attached to a naʿt of طعام [Note: If الحميم is what is drunk, or the pus of the Fire that heats the body, then (من غسلين) is, according to the apparent sense, the khabar of ليس.]; (لا) negative; the second (إلّا) is also for restriction.
The clause «ليس له ... حميم ...» is in the position of jussive as apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of an implied condition, i.e.: if this was his state in the world, then he has no ... [Note: Or the clause is conjoined by the fāʾ to the causal clause (إنّه كان لا يؤمن ...), and there is a sense of causation in it.].
The clause «لا يأكله إلّا الخاطئون» is in the position of genitive as a naʿt of غسلين.

* Morphology:
(21) عيشة: a maṣdar known by hearing (samāʿī) of the triliteral عاش, of the class of ضرب. Its pattern is فعلة with kasra then sukūn, so it is on the pattern of the maṣdar of manner (maṣdar al-hayʾa) ... There are other maṣdars of the verb: العيش on the pattern فعل with fatḥa then sukūn, معاش on the pattern مفعل with fatḥa on the mīm and the ʿayn, معيشة on the pattern مفعلة with fatḥa on the mīm and kasra on the ʿayn, and عيشوشة on the pattern فعلولة with fatḥa then sukūn.
(راضية): feminine of الراضي, active participle of the triliteral رضي. Its pattern is فاعلة [Note: It is figurative if it is in its usual sense, i.e. if it is in the sense of the passive participle; and literal if it is in the sense of relation (nisba), like تامر and لابن.].
(23) قطوف: plural of قطف, with kasra then sukūn, its pattern being فعل in the sense of مفعول, like الذّبح in the sense of المذبوح, i.e. the fruit that is picked. The pattern of قطوف is فعول with two ḍammas.
(24) الخالية: feminine of الخالي, active participle of the triliteral خلا يخلو, of the class of نصر. Its pattern is فاعل, and it contains iʿlāl (weak-letter change) by substitution: its original form is الخالو; the letter before the wāw came with kasra, so it was changed into yāʾ and it became الخالي. The pattern of الخالية is الفاعلة.
(25) أوت: it contains iʿlāl by deletion on account of the jussive. Its pattern is أفع, with ḍamma, then sukūn, then fatḥa.
(26) أدر: it contains iʿlāl by deletion on account of the jussive. Its pattern is أفع, with fatḥa, then sukūn, then kasra.
(31) صلّوه: it contains iʿlāl by deletion, beginning from the imperfect يصلّون — with ḍamma on the yāʾ and fatḥa on the doubled lām. Its original form is يصلّيون — with a yāʾ with ḍamma before the wāw; the ḍamma was felt heavy on the yāʾ, so it was made quiescent and the vowel was transferred to the lām before it — iʿlāl by making quiescent; then the yāʾ was deleted because it came together, quiescent, with the wāw of the plural, and it became يصلّون ... then the iʿlāl was carried over to the imperative صلّوه. Its pattern is فعّوه.
(32) ذرعها: the maṣdar of ذرع meaning "to measure", or a noun meaning length. Its pattern is فعل, with fatḥa then sukūn.
(سبعون): a numeral noun among the words for the tens, assimilated to the sound masculine plural. Its pattern is فعلون with fatḥa then sukūn.
(ذراعا): a noun for length or for the well-known limb. Its pattern is فعال with kasra on the fāʾ.
(34) طعام: it may be a quasi-maṣdar (ism maṣdar) of the quadriliteral verb أطعم, in the sense of الإطعام (feeding). Its pattern is فعال with fatḥa on the fāʾ ... see verse (259) of Sūrat al-Baqara.
(36) غسلين: a noun for what flows from wounds when they are washed; in the exegesis, it is the pus of the people of the Fire, or a tree that they eat. Its pattern is فعلين, with kasra, then sukūn, then kasra.

* Rhetoric:
Specification (al-takhṣīṣ): in His words «ثُمَّ فِي سِلْسِلَةٍ ذَرْعُها سَبْعُونَ ذِراعاً فَاسْلُكُوهُ».
Placing the chain before the inserting, like placing Hell before the roasting, is to indicate specification and concern, by mentioning the kinds of things with which he is punished; as though it were said: do not insert him except into this chain, as though it were more horrid than all the other places of oppression in Hell.

* Benefits:
- Inversion (al-qalb):
It occurs most often in poetry. Of it is the saying of Ruʾba:
ومهمه مغبرة أرجاؤه ... كأن لون أرضه سماؤه
(And many a desert whose sides are dusty, as if the colour of its earth were its sky.)
I.e. as if the colour of its sky, because of its dustiness, were the colour of its earth; so he reversed the simile for hyperbole, and omitted the muḍāf.
And ʿUrwa ibn al-Ward said
فديت بنفسه نفسي ومالي ... وما آلوك إلا ما أطيق
(I ransomed with his self my self and my wealth — and I do not withhold from you except what is beyond my power.)
